steps.content: The distant building still stands bathed in spotlights, wailing sirens surrounding it well into the night.
From the flickering televisions in nearby buildings, emergency news broadcasts repeat their warning: stay away from the Central Gallery.
Huff... huff...
Through the neon glow, several figures dart and swiftly disappear into a building.
Soon after, a soft white light flickers on in a small Eastside café.
Having changed out of their catsuits, the three sisters gathered in the cafe, cradling the piece of the Otherland Angels they just reclaimed.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: With this... we have two pieces now.
As Kisugi Rui gently places the pieces of Otherland Angels on the table, they emit a faint glow and the fracture lines begin to connect.
A surge of emotion follows. After everything, the complete Otherland Angels is about to be restored before them.

Yet, doubt tempers their hope. Collecting every piece does not guarantee a return to their original world. They still don't understand the source of the mysterious power within them, or its consequences.
And then there's the "Chief"...
Kisugi Hitomi remembers the Central Gallery rooftop. It was a perfect chance for apprehension, yet he just helped her fend off the monsters instead.
steps.female_content: Kisugi Hitomi remembers the Central Gallery rooftop. It was a perfect chance for apprehension, yet she helped her fend off the monsters instead.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: And... I noticed something. When he was helping me, that strange power inside me felt... less turbulent. Almost like it could be controlled.
steps.female_content: And... I noticed something. When she was helping me, that strange power inside me felt... less turbulent. Almost like it could be controlled.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: Hitomi's right... Earlier, my mind felt all hazy, and I was so frustrated I could hardly think straight...

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: Especially when I saw you surrounded by those monsters, Hitomi. I was so desperate I wanted to charge in and take everything down with me...
Kisugi Ai scratches her cheek, a sheepish expression crossing her face.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: But then that "Chief" showed up, and after that flash of red light... it was like all that darkness just lifted.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: Rui, you felt it too, right? That's when you calmed down enough to have me prep the drone so we could get Hitomi and leave.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: Yes. Whether tonight, or when he visited the café before... he's been guiding us, intentionally or not. Hinting about Sinners, Mania, Black Rings...
steps.female_content: Yes. Whether tonight, or when she visited the café before... she's been guiding us, intentionally or not. Hinting about Sinners, Mania, Black Rings...

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: Now that I've had time to think, I believe his goal isn't simply to capture us.
steps.female_content: Now that I've had time to think, I believe her goal isn't simply to capture us.

steps.content: Kisugi Rui reaches out and touches the pieces of Otherland Angels on the table. A faint, immediate glow wraps her fingers. Her own heartbeat pulses louder in response. Within her, the unsettling power stirs, rising toward the surface once more.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: We crossed into this world through that rift. With every operation, we witness scenes connected to it… and gradually begin to harness a power unlike any we've used before.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: It makes me certain now. The way home is tied to the Chief, and to this power.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: I agree with Rui.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: And now that I think about it... both pieces of Otherland Angels we've reclaimed were taken from government-sponsored exhibitions.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: That means the last piece of Otherland Angels is almost certainly in their hands, too.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: Then why don't we just reach out to him directly!
steps.female_content: Then why don't we just reach out to her directly!

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: Wait... but wouldn't that be like turning ourselves in?
With a sharp motion, Kisugi Ai produces a slip of paper and lays it on the counter. It's the very note that person once handed her—the one bearing the hotline's direct number.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: We can just say we got caught up in some trouble. It's not a lie, and it's not like we'd be turning ourselves in, right?
A gentle smile touches Kisugi Rui's lips. She then offers Ai some advice before Ai dials the number.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: Alrighty! I'm calling now!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Hello.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: Huh?! That was really fast!
After a few polite knocks, the café door opens.
Kisugi Rui greets you and guides you to your familiar spot at the bar.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: It seems... you really have been watching over us.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: At this point, I think we can speak openly, ladies.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Even without your call, I was planning to stop by tonight.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: ...So you have already figured everything out, Chief.
A hint of tension hangs in the air. You turn, pick up the menu from the counter, and speak softly to the sisters.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's getting late. Mind if I just have a glass of milk? Helps with sleep... and it's a comforting taste.
Kisugi Rui pauses for a moment, then smiles and steps behind the bar. She pours milk into a small pot and begins to warm it gently.
As the sweet, warm aroma fills the air, it dispels the lingering tension. You look at the three sisters and slowly begin to explain the situation.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You were right. I know who you really are: the art thieves known as Cat's Eye.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But don't worry. I'm not here to arrest you.
You take out the prepared photos and place them on the counter for the three sisters to see.
They show the familiar rift, along with those unsettling monsters that resemble black sludge.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You've been seeing these things a lot lately, haven't you?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: In our world, that's called a dimensional rift. It was artificially created, a product of Mania energy released during a Black Ring outbreak. It can affect two worlds across different timelines.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: A little over half a month ago, I detected one becoming active. Around the same time, a painting called the Otherland Angels started getting an unusual amount of attention.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Back then, I didn't connect it all. But when your heists became the talk of the town, two of my Sinners, Pricilla and Tetra...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Tetra, the one who crossed paths with Ai, mentioned that this didn't feel like an ordinary phantom thief's work. That's when I decided to look into it myself.
You take out a small object, place it on the table, and slide it toward Kisugi Ai.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: Oh, that's my gadget!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Sorry, we accidentally broke it back then. Tried to fix it up. Take a look.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's pretty clever, honestly. Those who specialize in inventing at our bureau couldn't stop praising the design.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: So... you were planning this from our very first meeting?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I had a plan, yes. But back then, I hadn't considered you might be from another world. I just wanted to gather intel so I could... handle everything neatly.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: After all, the three originals of Otherland Angels were in official custody.

When the Otherland Angels sparked an abnormal obsession, all of Eastside fell into a frenzy. The city's M-value began to rise, putting you on high alert and prompting an immediate dispatch of agents to locate the originals.

Perhaps by luck, or because fate intended for you to cross paths with the three phantom thieves, all three pieces ended up in the hands of good-natured people. Upon hearing the paintings might be connected to Mania, they immediately turned them over to the authorities.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: Then, Chief... if you're not here to arrest us, what are you here for?
Kisugi Rui steps out from behind the counter. She places a cup of warmed sweet milk beside you, then positions herself between you and her two younger sisters.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: You're essentially the police here. Three phantom thieves are right in front of you. Shouldn't you be taking us into your bureau, as you did with Pricilla and Tetra?
The milk's sweetness is comforting. Almost without realizing it, you bring the cup to your lips for another sip.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I might be a little different from the "police" you're thinking of, Miss Rui.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: By passing through the dimensional rift, you've been exposed to Mania, the energy that permeates this world. That makes you a type of person we call Sinners.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: A Sinner's power is tied to their psyche. If they're not... well-intentioned to begin with, losing control can lead to serious incidents.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: Like that serial criminal? The Marauders?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Exactly. But I know for certain you're not like that.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: In our previous encounters, you had plenty of chances to harm us. You could've taken hostages.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But you never did. That's why I'm here talking to you now.
You raise your hand and carefully release the shackles. A small, crimson wisp—like a living flame—materializes in your palm. Inexplicably, a profound calm washes over everyone present.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I have a power known as the shackles. I'm the Chief of the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control, an organization that manages Mania and Sinners like yourselves.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: At first, yes, I engaged with the intention of capturing you. But...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: We analyzed your operations. Your skills as phantom thieves are exceptional; your coordination and teamwork are flawless. That doesn't come from following trends or acting on a whim. More importantly... in every heist under the name Cat's Eye, you've only ever targeted the original Otherland Angels. Nothing else.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If the painting originally belonged to you, then your actions make perfect sense.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: You really are a kind person, Chief ${PlayerName}.
Kisugi Rui sits beside you, without blocking her sisters' view, and, as the eldest, addresses you with a question.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: In that case... what is your true purpose in coming here tonight?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I want to ensure your safety, to keep you untouched by the dangers of this world. Once we resolve the Otherland Angels case and apprehend the serial criminal... I intend to send you home.
Your words hang in the air. All three sisters stare, visibly taken aback.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: Home? You can help us get back?!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I don't know the exact method yet, but I believe it will require gathering every last piece of the Otherland Angels.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: That said… I can't simply return the last piece to you now. Not while the Marauders are still out there.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: How would you like us to cooperate?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: To lure them out... I need you to continue sending your calling cards and carrying out your heists. I'm serious.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'll provide you with intel on the third original piece's exhibition, while spreading word within my bureau that this is an operation to draw out the criminal.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's the best solution I could devise, one that doesn't force either of us to compromise our principles.
Kisugi Rui falls silent. She rests her chin on her hand, deep in thought as she mulls over the proposal.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: But... how can we trust you? Our opponent is the Marauders, vicious thieves with no regard for life. Against people that dangerous... what if the power inside us spirals out of control?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The power of my shackles can stabilize a Sinner's abilities when they verge on berserk, maximize their potential, and even compel obedience if needed. You should've felt it before.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But to achieve that level of control, I would need to form a "bond" with a Sinner.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: And that "bond"... doesn't actually require mutual consent. I could enforce it unilaterally, without issue.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: With you three... I've had plenty of opportunities.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: ...Yet you never acted.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: That's right. I don't want the shackles to be chains.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: Hehe...
By the counter, Kisugi Rui looks at you, her expression softening with a gentle smile.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: No matter which world I find myself in, it fills me with joy to be surrounded by such kind, wonderful people.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: We accept your proposal, Chief ${PlayerName}.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Thank you for your cooperation.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: You guessed correctly. We're not from this world, and neither is that painting. It was created by our dad.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: Back in our world, we've been operating as phantom thieves, reclaiming his works in hopes of finding clues to his whereabouts.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: So when we came to this world and found out that Dad's painting had split into three pieces, each one a separate original, we decided to keep operating as Cat's Eye and set out to track down the paintings.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I see...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Why you became phantom thieves, why you continue your operations here... Those are choices born from your world and your lives. It's not my place to judge.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Which is why... I have no right to make things difficult for you, or to force you to stay.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Prepare yourselves. I'll inform you about the exhibition in a few days.
You rise, finish the last of your milk, and leave a bill tucked neatly under the cup.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Thanks for the milk.
Kisugi Rui sees you to the door. She watches you go, remaining in the doorway long after you've vanished from sight.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: So kind, so brave... and so gentle.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: But...
Her final words are lost to you. Instead, you simply raise your hand in one last, silent wave of goodbye.
